objective: Verify semantic browser actions against fresh page state, accessibility/DOM evidence, postconditions, and artifact digests without allowing model output or provider protocol messages to become authority.

sources.finding: WebDriver BiDi defines bidirectional browser control with asynchronous commands, streamed events, modular browsing-context/input/network/script/session capabilities, and commands that may complete out of order.
sources.impact: M235 binds actions to page/session generations, pre-state evidence, action sequence, and post-state evidence rather than trusting command response order.

sources.finding: Chrome DevTools Protocol exposes DOM, input, network, debugger, and other browser instrumentation domains; its tip-of-tree protocol changes frequently without backward compatibility guarantees.
sources.impact: M235 treats DOM, accessibility, screenshot, network, download, and upload data as versioned evidence and keeps the contract vendor-neutral.

sources.finding: Playwright recommends role, label, text, placeholder, alt-text, title, and explicit test-ID locators, with auto-waiting and strictness; brittle CSS/XPath chains are discouraged.
sources.impact: M235 prioritizes semantic locators, requires unique matches and confidence, and policy-gates coordinate fallback.

sources.finding: Automated accessibility checks can identify some issues but do not replace manual or inclusive assessment.
sources.impact: M235 accepts accessibility-tree evidence as a verification signal but does not treat it as a complete safety or accessibility guarantee.

features: semantic locator kind and confidence metadata
freshness validation against an explicit policy clock
pre-action origin, URL, DOM, accessibility, and screenshot evidence binding
post-action observation and expected DOM digest binding
model proposal and browser authority separation

qualification_limits: M235 is a deterministic userspace browser-policy and receipt fixture, not a browser automation backend or live WebDriver BiDi/CDP client.
No live DOM, accessibility tree, screenshot, download, upload, or browser navigation was exercised in this milestone.
No live OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, vLLM, Playwright, Chromium, or external browser-provider call is part of this validation.
No physical accelerator, independent builder, independent security review, production PKI, or live multihost qualification was performed.
Production release remains blocked by the project’s external evidence gate.
